messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-03-10] standup/atlas/2025-03-10: Dependency map update: the billing service needs the ledger (invoice postings).
- [2025-09-09] standup/boreal/2025-09-09: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.
- [2025-09-08] standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2: New dependency for billing-api: feature-flags. Billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags; the reasoning is that the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. Boreal noticed that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners.
- [2026-05-26] handover/2026-05-26-billing-api: Ownership change: billing-api now sits with the Dune team. Boreal no longer owns it.
- [2025-03-17] handover/2025-03-17-billing-api: Atlas handed billing-api to team Boreal today; Tomasz wrote up the handover doc for Marcus.
- [2025-11-04] standup/boreal/2025-11-04: No deploys to the billing API from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 because of the peak season.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08: The ledger lives with Atlas. The billing service lives with team Atlas.
- [2025-05-05] standup/boreal/2025-05-05: Reminder that the billing service only ships on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC.
- [2025-12-23] standup/atlas/2025-12-23: The Atlas team noticed that the billing API's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.
- [2025-07-28] standup/cinder/2025-07-28-2: Heads-up from Cinder: the ledger's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. Observation from team Cinder: after the dependency bump, the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent.
- [2025-09-15] standup/dune/2025-09-15: We decided that reporting will read from the event-bus instead of querying the ledger directly. The reason: the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. That removes the dependency on Ledger from reporting.
- [2025-03-17] standup/atlas/2025-03-17: If the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down: it relies on it for service tokens.
- [2025-03-10] standup/dune/2025-03-10: The reports pipeline depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export.
- [2025-11-21] standup/dune/2025-11-21: Heads-up from team Dune: billing-api's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send.
- [2025-01-17] standup/boreal/2025-01-17: The notification service depends on the bus for delivery events. If the event bus is down, the webhook dispatcher is down: it relies on it for outbound events.
- [2025-04-08] standup/dune/2025-04-08: Reminder that the reporting service depends on the ledger.
- [2025-03-31] standup/boreal/2025-03-31: The event bus remains a Boreal service.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2: The notifier lives with Boreal. The webhooks service lives with Boreal.
- [2025-10-13] standup/cinder/2025-10-13: The monthly cost review is run by Yuki. Reminder that the search indexer depends on the catalog.
- [2025-02-25] standup/boreal/2025-02-25: Webhooks still relies on the bus; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2026-04-16] standup/ember/2026-04-16: The ledger service's deploy window changes today: it is now on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC. The old slot (Wednesdays 09:00-11:00 UTC) is retired.
- [2025-12-16] standup/ember/2025-12-16: The ledger service deploy window (unchanged): on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20-2: The auth gateway is a Ember service.
- [2025-05-23] standup/ember/2025-05-23: The Ember team saw that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-12-29] standup/ember/2025-12-29-2: Observation from team Ember: after the traffic shift, the auth gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent. The ledger remains a Ember service.
- [2025-06-23] standup/atlas/2025-06-23: The quarterly capacity review is run by Priya.
- [2025-08-14] standup/boreal/2025-08-14: Changes to auth-gateway need two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.
- [2025-08-29] standup/atlas/2025-08-29: Observation from Atlas: after the client rollout, the product catalog's request volume halved.
- [2026-05-18] standup/ember/2026-05-18-2: The Ember team noticed that auth-gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.
- [2025-09-12] standup/atlas/2025-09-12: Do not upgrade the ledger service past Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17: Team Cinder owns the catalog service.
- [2025-06-27] standup/boreal/2025-06-27: Boreal saw that the bus' request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
